adjudication.rationale: The claim about the sync endpoint response not including `signature`/`id` is not grounded in the diff as used here: `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` refreshes tokens by calling Salesforce directly via `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)`, not `refreshOAuthTokens`, so it is not consuming the documented CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT “access token and expiry only” response. Also, `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` explicitly bypasses the provided strict schema when app credential sharing + CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are enabled, using `minimumTokenResponseSchema` instead, so the strict `salesforceTokenSchema` requirements would not apply in the sync-endpoint mode. The overwrite of `key` does replace the stored key object, but the diff does not establish that any required extra fields exist beyond those preserved/spread (and `refresh_token` is explicitly retained), so “data loss” is not verifiable from the diff alone.
